meta.title: Souqna
meta.description: Buy and sell safely. Your money is held until you receive your item.

home.promiseTitle: Your money is safe until you receive your item
home.promiseBody: You pay us and we hold the money. The seller only gets it once the item reaches you and it's what you agreed.
home.step1: Pick an item and chat with the seller in the app.
home.step2: Pay, and we hold your money safely.
home.step3: Receive and check the item, then the money goes to the seller.
home.emptyFeed: No listings yet. Be the first to sell!

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Log in with your mobile number. No email needed.
login.phoneHint: Example: 0912345678. Your number is never shown to anyone.
login.resendIn: You can request a new code in {seconds} seconds

onboarding.title: Complete your profile
onboarding.intro: Your name and city are shown to people on your listings.
onboarding.displayNameHint: Don't include a phone number or link.

account.title: My account
account.phonePrivate: Your number is never shown to anyone.
account.signOutOthers: Log out of all other devices
account.signedOutOthers: You've been logged out of your other devices.
account.balanceNote: Withdrawals arrive in the next update.

search.title: Search
search.noResults: Nothing found. Try other words or change the filters.

listing.safety1: Never send money outside Souqna. When you pay in the app, we hold your money until you receive the item.
listing.safety2: Don't share your phone number or address in listings or chat.
listing.safety3: If a listing looks suspicious, report it.
listing.reportTitle: Why are you reporting this listing?
listing.owner_draft: This listing is a draft. Nobody else can see it.
listing.owner_pending_review: This listing is being reviewed. It goes live once we've checked it.
listing.owner_rejected: This listing was rejected. Edit it and send it again.
listing.owner_paused: This listing is paused. Nobody else can see it.
listing.owner_reserved: This listing is reserved in an active order.
listing.buyUnavailable: This item is reserved or sold.

sell.title: Sell something
sell.photosHint: Up to 8 photos. The first one is the cover.
sell.uploadFailed: Upload didn't work. Tap to try again.
sell.descriptionHint: Describe the condition, any faults, and why you're selling. No phone numbers.
sell.offline: You're offline. Your work is saved on this phone; you can publish when the connection is back.
sell.draftRestored: We restored the draft you were working on.
sell.policy: Not allowed: weapons, drugs, medicines, animals, stolen goods, and anything counterfeit.
sell.needsProfile: Complete your profile first so you can sell.

myListings.title: My listings
myListings.empty: You don't have any listings yet.
myListings.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this listing?

favourites.title: Saved listings
favourites.empty: You haven't saved any listings yet. Tap “Save” on a listing to find it here.

prohibited.title: What you can't sell on Souqna
prohibited.intro: To keep people safe, these items may not be sold on Souqna. Listings with them are removed, and accounts may be suspended.
prohibited.weapons: Weapons, ammunition and anything like them
prohibited.documents: Official documents: passports, national ID numbers, ID cards
prohibited.review: Some listings are reviewed by a person before they go live.

chat.title: Chats
chat.empty: No chats yet. Open any listing and tap “Chat with seller”.
chat.offerHint: It must be no more than the asking price of {price}.
chat.offerTooHigh: Your offer can’t be more than the asking price.
chat.offerAcceptedNote: The seller accepted. Buy at this price, with your money protected.
chat.waiting: Waiting for a connection. It will send by itself when you’re back online.
chat.maskedNote: We hid a phone number or link. Keep talking here: sharing contact details before ordering is how most scams start.
chat.offPlatformNote: Careful: only payments made through Souqna are protected. Never transfer money directly to anyone, by Bankak or cash.
chat.contactHint: Phone numbers and links are hidden until you place an order.
chat.safety1: Only pay through Souqna. We hold your money until you receive the item.
chat.safety2: Don’t share your number or address. We hide numbers and links in chat.
chat.safety3: If someone asks you to send money outside the app, report them.
chat.listingGone: This listing is no longer available, so you can’t send new messages.
chat.offerAcceptedSeller: You accepted. The buyer can now buy at this price.

checkout.title: Buy safely
checkout.how: You pay Souqna, and we hold the money until you have the item and have checked it. If something is wrong, you get your money back.
checkout.delivery_courier_hint: A courier collects from the seller and brings it to you.
checkout.delivery_meetup_hint: Meet the seller in a public place. You still pay through Souqna.
checkout.payment_bank_transfer_hint: Transfer to Souqna’s account and enter the transaction number.
checkout.payment_cod_hint: Pay the courier before they hand the item over.
checkout.refusal_cod_needs_history: Available after your first completed order.
checkout.refusal_cod_over_limit: The total is above the cash-on-delivery limit.
checkout.refusal_cod_needs_courier: Cash only with a Souqna courier.
checkout.refusal_meetup_needs_prepayment: For meetups you pay in advance through Souqna.
checkout.refusal_new_account_limit: Your account is new and this is above the first-week limit.
checkout.protectionHint: Covers holding your money safely and sorting out any problem.
checkout.payWithin: Pay within {hours} hours, or the order is cancelled automatically.
checkout.inspection: After delivery you have {hours} hours to check the item.

orders.title: My orders
orders.payStep3: And write the order number in the transfer note:
orders.paymentChecking: We received transaction {reference} and are checking it.
orders.action_confirm_received: I received it and it’s fine
orders.confirmCancel: Are you sure you want to cancel this order?
orders.confirmReceived: After you confirm, we pay the seller. Are you sure the item arrived and is as described?
orders.refunded: We’re refunding {amount} to you. It will be sent to your Bankak account.

orderInfo.created_buyer: Waiting for the seller to confirm. You’ll pay the courier in cash before they hand the item over.
orderInfo.created_seller: Cash-on-delivery order. Confirm the item is ready so we can send a courier.
orderInfo.awaiting_payment_buyer: Transfer the amount and enter the transaction number below. Souqna holds the money until you have the item.
orderInfo.awaiting_payment_seller: Waiting for the buyer to pay. Don’t hand over the item yet.
orderInfo.payment_submitted_buyer: We received your transaction number and are checking it, usually within a few hours (9am–9pm).
orderInfo.payment_submitted_seller: The buyer says they paid and we’re checking the transfer. Don’t hand over the item yet.
orderInfo.payment_rejected_buyer: Check the transaction number and send it again.
orderInfo.payment_rejected_seller: Waiting for the buyer to fix the payment.
orderInfo.funds_held_buyer: Paid. Your money is held safely by Souqna while the seller prepares the item.
orderInfo.funds_held_seller: Paid. The money is held safely by Souqna. Prepare the item and tap “The item is ready”.
orderInfo.ready_for_pickup_buyer: The seller has the item ready. Hand-over arrangements come next.
orderInfo.ready_for_pickup_seller: Great. Hand-over arrangements (courier or meetup) arrive in the next update.
orderInfo.delivered_buyer: Got it? Check it and tap “I received it and it’s fine”. If you don’t, we confirm automatically when the time is up.
orderInfo.delivered_seller: Delivered. The buyer has some time to check the item; then the money comes to you.
orderInfo.completed_seller: Completed. As a new seller your money is held for a short time, then it becomes available.
orderInfo.payout_released_seller: Completed. The money is in your available balance.
orderInfo.cancelled_seller: This order was cancelled and your listing is live again.
orderInfo.expired_buyer: The seller didn’t hand over in time, so the order was cancelled and your money is coming back to you.
orderInfo.expired_seller: You didn’t hand over in time, so the order was cancelled and the listing paused. Check it and relist it if it’s still available.

admin.title: Payment checks
admin.mfaHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
admin.mfaNotEnrolled: You don’t have two-step verification yet. Ask a system administrator to set it up.
admin.checkHint: Check the bank statement: exact amount, transaction number, and the order number in the note.
